title: What if you never went to the doctor?

lines.text: What if you never... ever... went to the doctor?
Year one. You feel great. Check-ups? Who needs them.
lines.label: YEAR 1

lines.text: Sweetie, you should really get that looked at.
lines.speaker: mom

lines.text: Year three. Your blood pressure is creeping up... and high blood pressure usually has no symptoms at all.
lines.label: YEAR 3

lines.text: Year five. That tiny cavity you ignored? It's now a toothache you can't sleep through.
lines.label: YEAR 5

lines.text: Year ten. Something finally feels wrong. So you go.
lines.label: YEAR 10

lines.text: If we'd caught this five years ago, it would have been one simple prescription.
lines.speaker: doctor

lines.text: Most serious problems are easiest to treat when they're caught early.
So book that check-up. Future you says thanks.
